sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Dm/A]Will your anchor hold in the [F/C]storm of life,
[F]When the clouds unfold [Dm/F]their wings of strife?
[C7/Bb]When the strong tides lift, [Dm/A]and the cables [C/G]strain,
[Dm/A]Will your anchor drift, or firm remain?

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [F/C]We have an anchor that [C]keeps the soul
[C]Steadfast and sure while the billows roll,
[C/G]Fastened to the Rock which cannot move,
[Dm/F]Grounded firm and deep [C/E]in the Savior's love.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Dm/A]It is safely moored, 'twill the [F/C]storm withstand,
[F]For 'tis well secured [Dm/F]by the Savior's hand;
[C7/Bb]And the cables passed [Dm/A]from His heart [C/G]to mine,
[Dm/A]Can defy the blast, through strength divine.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Dm/A]It will firmly hold in the [F/C]straits of fear,
[F]When the breakers have [Dm/F]told the reef is near;
[C7/Bb]Though the tempest rave [Dm/A]and the wild [C/G]winds blow,
[Dm/A]Not an angry wave shall our bark o'erflow.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [Dm/A]It will surely hold in the [F/C]floods of death,
[F]When the waters cold [Dm/F]chill our latest breath;
[C7/Bb]On the rising tide [Dm/A]it can never [C/G]fail,
[Dm/A]While our hopes abide within the veil.

sections.name: Verse 5
lines: [Dm/A]When our eyes behold, in the [F/C]dawning light,
[F]Shining gates of [Dm/F]pearl, our harbor bright,
[C7/Bb]We shall anchor fast to [Dm/A]the heavenly [C/G]shore,
[Dm/A]With the storms all past forevermore.
